profile.reading: Per Equinix own site (its DA1 Dallas building page), the Infomart building housing multiple Equinix Dallas suites is located at 1950 North Stemmons Freeway, Dallas, TX 75207. This OSM/registry entry is tagged generically as Equinix Infomart rather than a specific numbered suite (Equinix operates several numbered facilities, e.g. DA1, within this shared multi-tenant building), so a single suite-level square footage or capacity figure is not asserted for this entry; the address is confirmed at the building level.
profile.capacity_note: Registry entry represents the shared Infomart building, not one specific numbered Equinix suite; no single-suite MW or sqft figure is asserted

profile.regional_context: Equinix states its Dallas facilities run on 100% renewable energy coverage and guarantee 99.9999%+ uptime, connecting major cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle, and IBM Cloud.
profile.facility_type_note: Equinix Dallas data center; the Dallas metro is described by Equinix as home to the largest internet exchange in the South Central US, with 8 facilities (DA1-DA4, DA6-DA7, DA9, DA11); DA1-DA3 were the original International Business Exchange locations established for telecom carriers.
